en: A black‑and‑white postcard view of a large brick railway station building with arched windows and a small tower or cupola on the roof. The scene shows a cobblestone street in the foreground and bare trees framing the image, suggesting late autumn or winter. In the lower left corner, printed caption text identifies the location, and a handwritten number appears in the lower right.
